title: Gemini functionResponse.response must be a JSON object; wrap non-object tool content as {"result": ...}
answers: AI Gateway fails with a 500 on a multi-turn tool call to Gemini when the tool result is plain text
Gemini tool calling through the gateway errors with JSONDecodeError on tool message content
Why does a non-JSON tool result break the Gemini request on Vertex AI through MLflow gateway?
body:
Symptom: A multi-turn tool-calling chat through the AI Gateway to Gemini (or Gemini on Vertex AI) fails with a 500 as soon as a tool result is plain text, an empty string, a list of content parts, or null, or when it is JSON that is not an object.
Root cause: mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py:GeminiAdapter.chat_to_model called json.loads(message["content"]) directly for every role "tool" message and passed the result as functionResponse.response.
Fix pattern: Route tool content through mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py:_tool_result_to_response. It returns a parsed JSON object unchanged and wraps anything else (non-JSON, non-object JSON, None, list of parts) as {"result": <content>}.
Constraints: Gemini requires response to be an object, so any new code that builds functionResponse must go through this helper. Vertex AI inherits the fix via super().chat_to_model. Grouping parallel tool calls is a separate concern and is not handled here.
applies: Any change to how tool-role messages become Gemini functionResponse parts in mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py, including the Vertex AI adapter that reuses chat_to_model.
says: Multi-turn Gemini chat crashes with a server error when a tool returns plain text.
AI gateway tool calling fails if the function result is not formatted as JSON.
Allow Gemini models on Vertex AI to handle tool outputs containing lists or empty strings.
Tool execution responses returning null or non-object data break the chat conversation.
search: Gemini tool call responses require functionResponse.response to be a JSON object, wrapping non-object or non-JSON content into a dictionary with a result key. In mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py, GeminiAdapter.chat_to_model uses _tool_result_to_response to pass parsed JSON objects unchanged while wrapping strings, null values, lists, and non-object JSON as {"result": <content>}. The Vertex AI adapter inherits this logic via super().chat_to_model, while parallel tool call grouping is not handled. It applies to any change in mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py converting tool-role messages into Gemini functionResponse parts.
